messages:
emma: Kicking off a short thread to align on the security/compliance items we need in next quarter's roadmap. SOC2 audit prep, immutable audit logs, KMS/HSM options, and data retention policy are the big asks from enterprise customers. Can we call out must-haves vs stretch?

kai: +1. We should separate product-level requirements (API for BYOK) from infra-level (HSM appliances). Engineering capacity is limited; need to propose phased approach.

lina: From risk perspective: SOC2 controls require auditable logs + key management. Immutable logs for 1 year is what large customers ask for, but storage/cost is non-trivial. HSM gives stronger assurance but adds ops surface.

sachin: Sales is pushing for "hardware-backed keys" in two deals. They want an explicit launch criteria bullet we can share. Can we draft a minimal acceptance checklist?

maria: Suggestion for phased plan: 1) Audit logs v1 (append-only bucket + integrity hashes) 2) KMS with BYOK support (cloud KMS integrations) 3) HSM gateway (partner-led or opc). Each phase has clear rollout criteria.

emma: Agree. Drafting checklist idea: - Audit logs: retention policy config + API to export logs within 48hrs; tamper-evidence (hash chain). - KMS: BYOK + envelope encryption + rotation policy + audit trail. - HSM: proof-of-concept with partner, documented threat model and runbook.

kai: Implementation notes: for audit logs we can use S3 immutable objects + Dynamo index for metadata. Proposed config snippet: ```yaml
audit_logs:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 365
  immutability: true
  export_window_hours: 48
  integrity: sha256-chain
```

lina: That config looks fine as an initial spec. Two caveats: 1) retention_days must be configurable per-tenant (enterprise vs standard). 2) We need legal signoff on retention defaults and deletion workflows.

sachin: Launch criteria draft (for PM/SDR handoff): - SOC2 control mapping updated + attestation timeline - Audit logs v1 GA (config + export API) - KMS BYOK supported for at-rest keys - Security runbook & incident playbook updated - Pricing & cost impact doc shared with sales

security-bot: Reminder: last SOC2 readiness review was 2024-10-12. Next compliance checkpoint scheduled in 3 weeks.

emma: Scope negotiation point — propose we treat HSM as "enterprise opt-in" (post-GA). First public milestone should be Audit logs + KMS BYOK. HSM can be an on-prem or partner integration for top-tier customers. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

kai: +1. That reduces initial delivery risk. For HSM gateway, we can design a shim interface so customers using HSM vs KMS look the same to the rest of the stack.

maria: Ops/Cost note: If we keep 365d immutable logs for all accounts it will spike storage. Recommend default 90d for self-serve, 365d for enterprise with price uplift.

lina: Action items: - @kai: tech spec for audit logs (due in 1 week) - @maria: cost model for retention tiers (due in 4 business days) - @sachin: customer promise language + sales FAQ (due in 5 business days) - @emma: update roadmap doc & OKR alignment (due EOW)

emma: Sounds good. I'll put these into the roadmap PR and tag the security OKR. If anyone needs to change owners ping me. :thumbsup:

sachin: One more ask from the field: customers want an explicit SLA around export times for legal discovery. Recommend we add "export SLA: 48 hours for enterprise" to the checklist.

emma: Added. I'll include SLA and a fallback plan (if export fails, notify legal/team within 2 hours).

kai: Quick question — do we want a small spike to evaluate HSM partners (Thales, Entrust) or open-source HSM proxies? I can schedule a 2-day spike if we greenlight.

lina: Yes please. Two-day spike for partner evaluation makes sense. Keep it focused: integration complexity, attestation level (FIPS), and ongoing operational burden.

maria: I'll also model cost delta for HSM-backed keys vs cloud KMS.

emma: Great. Closing the loop: I'll create the roadmap ticket, include the checklist, and set calendar invites for the spike review. Thanks everyone.
